verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud docs state official SDK support for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust. The open-source Orama JS library has detailed usage docs (create, insert, insertMultiple, vector and hybrid search), and its APIs are designed to mirror the Cloud APIs so projects can move between the two. Missing for 10: detailed docs or examples for the Python and Rust SDKs, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on confirmation of SDK quality.
